QuestInfo.name: Mercedes, the Young Queen
QuestInfo.0: Athena said she has news about one of the five heroes. Better find out what it is.
QuestInfo.1: Athena Pierce thinks the easiest way to contact Mercedes is to travel to Elluel, home of the elves.
QuestInfo.2: Elluel seems different from Athena Pierce's description of the town. It looks very peaceful and cozy.

0.0: Did you find Afrien? Yeah... He's been getting worse and worse ever since the curse was broken. Anyway Shade, I think it'd be best to go to Elluel if you want to meet Mercedes.
0.1: Mercedes is currently adventuring, but she stops by Elluel now and then. The town might be a little gloomy because of the curse, but I'm sure they'll treat you right if they know you're a friend of Mercedes.
0.2: Go to Elluel and meet #rPhilius#k. I've already told him about you. The road to Elluel is quite complicated, so I'll send you near the town. Do you want to go there right now?\r\n#r(You will be moved directly to the map if you accept.)

no.0: I can't tell you where Mercedes is. Even if I hear something, by the time I get back to you she'll have moved on.

1.0: This is the domain of the elves. What brings you here, human?

yes.0: Athena Pierce? Ah, you must be Shade. She told me about you.
